correctness.rationale: The labelled graph definitions have degree three, so no tie ambiguity. Opposite-rung propagation gives fixed counts, a characteristic-polynomial calculation establishes the cyclic word count, and explicit temporal bipartite cover isomorphisms determine every two-step return. A bounded integer majority energy rules out higher periods, and exact Lucas identities give the signed difference. Independent microscopic enumeration for both graph families over 3<=n<=10 (2,796,160 configurations), edge-bijection tests to n=30, and integral sequence tests to n=1000 all pass; finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The paired graphs have the same number of vertices and all degrees three, differing only by one seam identification. The result fully classifies recurrent majority orbits, and the naturally defined boundary-twist response changes sign exactly for rung counts 1,5 mod 6 while remaining exponentially smaller than the bulk orbit count. This is a structurally motivated exact invariant and not a fixed-table recomputation.
